blocks.html: Return on Investment (ROI) is a financial performance metric used to evaluate the profitability of an investment. It compares the net profit generated to the total cost invested, typically expressed as a percentage.

ROI is one of the most widely used metrics in business and marketing to assess the efficiency and effectiveness of investments. It helps organizations determine whether a campaign, project, or initiative is generating sufficient returns relative to its cost. A higher ROI indicates better financial performance and value creation.
ROI is calculated using the formula:

items.title: Net Profit
items.html: is the revenue gained minus costs

items.title: Total Investment Cost
items.html: includes all expenses related to the investment

blocks.html: It can be applied to marketing campaigns, sales initiatives, technology investments, and more.
A company spends ₹1,00,000 on a marketing campaign and generates ₹1,50,000 in profit. The ROI is 50%.
ROI is a critical financial metric that measures the profitability of investments and helps businesses make informed, performance-driven decisions.
